name: Shadow Slave
overview: Shadow Slave is a highly popular, ongoing dark progression fantasy web novel written by Guiltythree. The story blends LitRPG mechanics, psychological horror, and deep, Dark Souls-inspired world-building. It follows a cynical street orphan named Sunless (Sunny) as he navigates a brutal apocalyptic reality governed by a supernatural entity known as the Nightmare Spell.
